findings.explanation: The English removes the named controller button.

findings.evidenceJa: 軽い気持ちの選択ミス
findings.governingReading: A mistaken choice made casually or lightly
findings.explanation: The English changes the player’s careless attitude into a claim that the choice itself is simple.

findings.evidenceJa: シロウじゃどうあってもセイバーには勝てない
findings.governingReading: There is no way Shirou can defeat Saber
findings.explanation: The English preserves defeat but drops its unconditional force.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜ちゃんは超絶パワーアップをする
findings.governingReading: Sakura receives an utterly extraordinary power-up
findings.explanation: The English weakens the comic superlative into ordinary degree.

findings.highlight: I thought I could take a big part in this route
findings.evidenceJa: このルートこそわたしの出番かと思ったら
findings.governingReading: I thought this route would finally be my turn in the spotlight
findings.explanation: The English uses malformed idiom and weakens Illya’s expectation that this was specifically her route to shine.

findings.highlight: I’m forced to come back to this dojo
findings.evidenceJa: こうやって道場に出戻りしたのでした
findings.governingReading: That is how I ended up back at the dojo
findings.explanation: The English adds external compulsion to Illya’s comic return.

findings.evidenceJa: いじめられっ子が実は一番うたれ強い
findings.governingReading: The bullied child turns out to be the one most able to take a beating
findings.explanation: The English loses the physical-resilience wordplay that motivates the sisters joke.

findings.highlight: I hate how everyone was putting their masks on.
findings.evidenceJa: みんな猫被ってて困っちゃう
findings.governingReading: Everyone is putting on an innocent facade, which is such a nuisance
findings.explanation: The English copies the facade idea into unnatural plural mask language and changes Illya’s complaint.

findings.highlight: if my affection points are below four
findings.evidenceJa: わたしの好感度が４以下だったり
findings.governingReading: If Illya’s affection is four or lower
findings.explanation: The English excludes a score of exactly four, changing the true-ending condition.

findings.governingReading: Cheeesto—an attack cry that also literally reads “chest”
findings.explanation: The English presents an ordinary body-part word without preserving the attack-cry function.

findings.evidenceJa: 優柔不断を貫くがよい
findings.governingReading: See your indecision through to the end
findings.explanation: The English is awkward and loses the mock-heroic idea of unwavering commitment to indecision.
